label: PF Backlog 512
title: E6: shift-left spec/design gate (testable acceptance criteria + NFR targets + enumerated edge/error cases) before implementation
body:
## Problem / why
Ambiguous or non-testable requirements and missing NFRs are caught today at review (late); catch them at design.

## Acceptance criteria
A pre-implementation gate requires every requirement to have testable acceptance criteria, explicit NFR targets
(perf/security/availability), and enumerated edge/error cases; wired to spec_review/design_critic; fail-closed.

## Out of scope
Authoring the requirements (the design agent does).
